title: Vacationing in the Time of Covid

sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。
现在是八月，度假的季节。

sentences.en: We're vacationing in a kind of gray zone, a quasi-post-COVID world.
sentences.zh: 我们在某种灰色地带度假，一个准后新冠的世界。

sentences.en: We're navigating regulations and rules, but above all, our own tolerance for risk.
sentences.zh: 我们正在适应各种规章制度，但最重要的是，适应我们自己对风险的承受能力。

sentences.en: Producer Crystal Duhaime and my colleagues at the Times podcast First Person tell the story of one man whose decision to resume his favorite form of travel was especially perilous.
sentences.zh: 制片人克里斯塔尔·迪海姆以及我在《纽约时报》播客《第一人称》的同事们，讲述了一个男人的故事，他决定恢复自己最喜欢的旅行方式，而这充满了危险。

sentences.en: Welcome to Travel and Cruise Industry News.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看旅游与邮轮业新闻。

sentences.en: Coming to you from Bedford County in Central Virginia.
sentences.zh: 节目由弗吉尼亚州中部的贝德福德县为您播出。

sentences.en: I first came across Chile on YouTube, where almost every day he does a live stream all about cruises.
sentences.zh: 我最初是在 YouTube 上发现希利的，他几乎每天都在那里做关于邮轮的直播。

sentences.en: Got a lot of stuff on the agenda for this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有很多事情要处理。

sentences.en: Cruise ship sailing today from U.S.
For more than a year, the cruise industry shut down because of COVID.
sentences.zh: 由于新冠疫情，邮轮业停摆了一年多。

sentences.en: But at the end of January, Chile was getting ready to go on his first cruise since the pandemic started.
sentences.zh: 但在1月底，希利正准备踏上他自大流行开始以来的第一次邮轮之旅。

sentences.en: In Miami, Freedom of the Seas, who I will be on in, what's it now, 59 days or something?
sentences.zh: 在迈阿密，“海洋自由号”，我现在将在上面待，是多少天来着，59天还是什么的？

sentences.en: A few days before Chile was scheduled to board the Freedom of the Seas, I went to visit him.
sentences.zh: 在希利预定登船“海洋自由号”几天前，我去拜访了他。

sentences.en: You don't have to take shoes off.
This is my sister, Jean, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这是我姐姐吉恩。

sentences.en: He lives in Forest, Virginia, with his sister and her family.
sentences.zh: 他和姐姐及家人住在弗吉尼亚州的福雷斯特。

sentences.en: And if you hear the cats in the background, we have two cats running around.
sentences.zh: 如果你听到背景里有猫叫，我们有两只猫到处跑。

sentences.en: We call them our COVID kitties.
We rescued them during the first part of the pandemic, and their names are Charmin and Cottonelle.
sentences.zh: 我们在大流行初期救了它们，它们的名字叫查明和科顿内尔。

sentences.en: So, and then through here, which is my bedroom, actually, it's also where I record all my shows.
sentences.zh: 然后穿过这里，这其实是我的卧室，也是我录制所有节目的地方。

sentences.en: I have, of course, I call it my big butt microphone.
sentences.zh: 我有，当然，我称之为我的“大屁股麦克风”。

sentences.en: Uh, but this is, uh, this is where I do all my craziness from.
sentences.zh: 呃，不过这就是，呃，这就是我进行所有疯狂创作的地方。

sentences.en: And then, of course, I travel away from here whenever I can to go on cruises, which I'm getting ready to do.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，只要有机会，我就会离开这里去坐邮轮，我正准备这么做。

sentences.en: As you could tell, I was getting a little out of breath.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，我刚才有点喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Aggravating part of the, of being on oxygen.
sentences.zh: 吸氧最折磨人的地方就在于此。

sentences.en: I do fine sitting, walking, standing, 30, 40 yards total.
sentences.zh: 我坐着、走动、站立都没问题，总共走30、40码。

sentences.en: And I got to give myself a little jolt.
sentences.zh: 然后我得给自己来个小冲击。

sentences.en: And it takes, you know, a second or two.
sentences.zh: 这需要，你知道，一两秒钟。

sentences.en: Now, this was one of the four original rooms that was built in 1904.
sentences.zh: 现在，这是1904年建造的四个原始房间之一。

sentences.en: So, you want me to go back to the, I was born and raised and things?
sentences.zh: 所以，你想让我回到我出生、长大这些事上吗？

sentences.en: Well, I was born and raised in Roanoke, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在弗吉尼亚州罗阿诺克出生并长大。

sentences.en: I'm doing, doing it too loud.
It's a little bit too loud.
Well, my real name is Charles Mason Falls, Jr.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的真名是小查尔斯·梅森·福尔斯。

sentences.en: Everybody's called me Chili all my life, except for one teacher who refused to use nicknames.
sentences.zh: 我一生中每个人都叫我希利，只有一个拒绝使用昵称的老师除外。

sentences.en: My sister decided when I was born that I was going to be Little Chili.
sentences.zh: 我出生时，我姐姐决定让我当小希利。

sentences.en: So, I was Little Chili as long as my father was alive.
sentences.zh: 所以，只要我父亲还活着，我就是小希利。

sentences.en: My father was a disabled veteran from World War II.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是第二次世界大战的伤残退伍军人。

sentences.en: He was one of the first people in the family.
sentences.zh: 他是家里最早的一批人之一。

sentences.en: Chili's parents weren't cruisers, but his mom did take Chili on vacations to the beach.
sentences.zh: 希利的父母不怎么坐邮轮，但他妈妈确实带希利去海滩度假。

sentences.en: I remember the first time we went to Virginia Beach, for instance, camping trips to Myrtle Beach, several trips in the summer up to New England.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们第一次去弗吉尼亚海滩，比如去默特尔比奇露营，夏天去新英格兰的好几次旅行。

sentences.en: I mean, yes, she was my mom and she would fuss at me for doing bad things.
sentences.zh: 我是说，是的，她是我妈妈，我做坏事时她会唠叨我。

sentences.en: But because of that travel, I just, I loved being around the ocean.
sentences.zh: 但因为那次旅行，我就是，我太喜欢待在海洋附近了。

sentences.en: When did you realize that cruising was not only something that you like to do, but maybe part of your identity?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候意识到，坐邮轮不仅是你的爱好，可能还成了你身份的一部分？

sentences.en: Oh, that's a very tough question for me.
sentences.zh: 哦，这对我是个很难的问题。

sentences.en: Chili went on his first cruise in 1978.
sentences.zh: 希利在1978年进行了他的第一次邮轮之旅。

sentences.en: A group of friends invited him and his second wife to join them on the Carnival Festival.
sentences.zh: 一群朋友邀请他和他的第二任妻子加入他们的狂欢节节日号。

sentences.en: It left from Los Angeles and went to the Mexican Riviera, which had three ports of call, Mazatlan, Cabo San Lucas, and Puerto Vallarta.
sentences.zh: 它从洛杉矶出发前往墨西哥里维埃拉，有三个停靠港，马萨特兰、卡波圣卢卡斯和巴亚尔塔港。

sentences.en: We were in some rough seas a couple times on that seven-day cruise, but it just, it didn't bother me.
sentences.zh: 在那次为期七天的航行中，我们几次遇到风浪，但这只是，这并没有困扰我。

sentences.en: What was it about that first experience that you fell in love with?
sentences.zh: 那次初体验究竟有什么让你坠入爱河？

sentences.en: The entertainment, the food, the bars.
I have been just about everywhere that you can go in the Caribbean, from the Bahamas to all the Mexico East Coast ports, Panama, Colombia, Jamaica.
sentences.zh: 加勒比海几乎所有你能去的地方我都去过，从巴哈马到墨西哥东海岸的所有港口、巴拿马、哥伦比亚、牙买加。

sentences.en: I've been to St. Thomas, St. Kitts, St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 我去过圣托马斯、圣基茨、圣路易斯。

sentences.en: I go to buffet breakfast, and right after breakfast, I work on my vegetable level.
sentences.zh: 我去吃自助早餐，早餐后马上，我就开始补充蔬菜。

sentences.en: I go to the first bar that's open and get a Bloody Mary, which has tomatoes, and it's usually got a stalk of celery, it might have an olive, it might have a pickle,
sentences.zh: 我走到第一家开门的酒吧点一杯血腥玛丽，里面有西红柿，通常还有一根西芹，可能还有一颗橄榄，可能有一片泡菜，

sentences.en: and I like to take that and go get in a hot tub.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢拿着这个去泡热水澡。
格林纳达、阿鲁巴、博内尔岛、库拉索。

sentences.en: There's always a new person to meet, something different on every port.
sentences.zh: 总有新的人要见，每个港口都有不同的东西。

sentences.en: Sitting in a hot tub with a priest, we talked about religion, and we talked about the world.
sentences.zh: 和一个神父坐在热水澡里，我们聊了宗教，我们聊了世界。

sentences.en: I walked across the bar, stark naked, sat on my barstool, and said,
sentences.zh: 我赤身裸体穿过酒吧，坐在我的高脚凳上，说，

sentences.en: Excuse me, bartender, may I have another bourbon and Diet Coke, please?
sentences.zh: 打扰一下，酒保，请再给我一杯波旁威士忌加健怡可乐好吗？

sentences.en: Now, I may have had an adult beverage or two before I did that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在我做那件事之前，我可能喝了一两杯成人饮料。

sentences.en: I ended up with a hot date.
sentences.zh: 我最终有了一次火热的约会。
特克斯和凯科斯群岛、特立尼达、加拿大。

sentences.en: Back in those days, it was just going, you'd party, and you'd come home with a seven-day hangover and not even think about it.
sentences.zh: 在那样的日子里，就是去玩，去派对，然后带着七天的宿醉回家，甚至都不会去想它。

sentences.en: Bingo and trivia contests, game shows.
sentences.zh: 宾果游戏和常识问答比赛，游戏秀。

sentences.en: So, there's something to do, literally, all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以，字面意思上，随时都有事情可做。

sentences.en: There's an art gallery on almost every ship.
sentences.zh: 几乎每艘船上都有一个艺术画廊。

sentences.en: They have fabulous art on some ships.
sentences.zh: 有些船上有极好的艺术品。
对我来说是崭新的鹿特丹号。

sentences.en: Can you tell me the last cruise that you were on?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你坐的最后一艘邮轮是什么吗？

sentences.en: My last cruising was side to sides.
sentences.zh: 我最后一次邮轮旅行是背靠背的。

sentences.en: I was on the Zeider Dam and then the Carnival Sunrise.
sentences.zh: 我坐了须德海 Dam 号，然后是狂欢节日出号。

sentences.en: I got home on the 2nd of March, and then everything shut down in the cruise industry because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我在3月2日回到家，然后整个邮轮业因为大流行而关闭了。

sentences.en: When cruising shut down, Chile's world got really small.
sentences.zh: 当邮轮业关闭时，希利的世界变得非常小。

sentences.en: He spent months at home in Virginia, watching cruise after cruise get canceled.
sentences.zh: 他在弗吉尼亚的家中度过了几个月，看着一艘又一艘邮轮被取消。

sentences.en: Then, in November 2020, he started feeling off.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2020年11月，他开始感到不舒服。

sentences.en: He thought he had a urinary tract infection, and he went to his doctor.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己得了尿路感染，便去看了医生。

sentences.en: His doctor decided to check for prostate cancer.
sentences.zh: 他的医生决定检查前列腺癌。
他开了一项前列腺特异性抗原检测。

sentences.en: PSA readings over 10 often mean there's trouble.
sentences.zh: 前列腺特异性抗原读数超过10通常意味着有麻烦。
我的第一次前列腺特异性抗原检测是484。

sentences.en: Yes, in fact, I had prostate cancer.
sentences.zh: 是的，事实上，我得了前列腺癌。

sentences.en: Mine had spread throughout my entire body.
sentences.zh: 我的癌细胞已经扩散到全身。

sentences.en: It was in some 60 different places, including my lungs.
sentences.zh: 它在大约60个不同的地方，包括我的肺部。

sentences.en: Because I was a smoker for 56 years,
they wanted to do a test to make sure I didn't have lung cancer.
sentences.zh: 他们想做个检查以确保我没有得肺癌。

sentences.en: In fact, I had prostate cancer in the lungs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我肺部也有前列腺癌。

sentences.en: Within a few months, he was also put on oxygen and had to go to respiratory therapy three times a week.
sentences.zh: 几个月内，他还戴上了氧气面罩，不得不每周去进行三次呼吸治疗。

sentences.en: I will never be cancer-free, but it's under control because of the chemo that should, hopefully, keep everything in balance and the PSA doesn't go up.
sentences.zh: 我永远不可能彻底摆脱癌症，但在化疗的控制下它得到了控制，希望这能让一切保持平衡，前列腺特异性抗原不会上升。

sentences.en: If I didn't have a future ahead where I could get back on my boats, I could get back at sea, I'm not sure how I would handle it.
sentences.zh: 如果我的未来没有能够让我重新回到船上、重新回到大海的希望，我不知道自己会怎么应对。

sentences.en: Happiest on a boat, on the water.
And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看《重构者》，这是一个专注于设计之爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night, you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在我在夜总会当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，每天晚上，你都要带着300件你最珍贵的传家宝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了这样一个充满活力、由精美的50年历史文物组成的快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: Packing is something that I'm terrible at.
sentences.zh: 收拾行李是我最不擅长的事。

sentences.en: But I do it last minute.
sentences.zh: 但我总是拖到最后一刻。

sentences.en: So I end up missing things.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是会落下东西。

sentences.en: But basically, I start thinking about what I have from the skin out.
sentences.zh: 不过基本上，我会从贴身衣物开始考虑自己有什么。

sentences.en: So the first thing I do is grab underwear.
sentences.zh: 所以我做的第一件事就是拿内衣。

sentences.en: The second thing I grab is socks.
sentences.zh: 我拿的第二件事是袜子。

sentences.en: They usually have one and sometimes two fancy dinners where everybody on the ship will dress up a little bit.
sentences.zh: 他们通常会有一到两次的高级晚宴，船上的每个人都会稍微盛装打扮一番。

sentences.en: I got a new sport coat.
sentences.zh: 我买了一件新的运动西装外套。

sentences.en: But yes, I ordered a new sport coat because it's been years since I had a new one.
sentences.zh: 不过对的，我订购了一件新的运动西装外套，因为我已经好几年没买过新外套了。

sentences.en: So I called my friendly tailor.
sentences.zh: 所以我打电话给我的老裁缝朋友。

sentences.en: I went in to get measured because I had no idea what I would wear.
sentences.zh: 我去了店里量尺寸，因为我完全不知道自己该穿什么。

sentences.en: My body has changed a lot this past two years.
sentences.zh: 这两年我的身材变化很大。

sentences.en: So it's over here in the closet,
sentences.zh: 所以它就在这边的衣柜里，

sentences.en: which is a disaster waiting to happen.
sentences.zh: 那是一个随时可能爆发的灾难现场。

sentences.en: It's a navy blue sport coat with a little hanky in the pocket.
sentences.zh: 那是一件海军蓝的运动西装外套，口袋里还插着一块小方巾。

sentences.zh: 你能给吉姆打个电话到他的店里，问问我的衬衫到了吗？

sentences.en: And if it did, pick it up.
sentences.zh: 如果到了，就顺便帮我取回来。

sentences.en: Chili had been working on strengthening his lungs.
sentences.zh: 奇利一直在努力锻炼肺活量。

sentences.en: Normally, he would have gone to respiratory therapy at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，他本该去医院接受呼吸治疗。

sentences.en: But there was a surge in COVID cases.
So Chili decided to do some of his exercises at home.
sentences.zh: 所以奇利决定在家做一些锻炼。

sentences.en: I'm going to switch legs and leave with the other leg.
sentences.zh: 我要换一只脚，用另一只脚带步。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people would think,
oh, Chili, you're probably the last person who should be traveling during a respiratory pandemic, given your needs for oxygen and your difficulties.
sentences.zh: 天哪，奇利，考虑到你对氧气的需求和身体的困难，你可能是最不应该在呼吸道大流行期间旅行的人。

sentences.en: Do you have any doubts at all about going onto a cruise ship in a few days?
sentences.zh: 几天后就要登上游轮，你一点都不怀疑吗？

sentences.en: believe, just as much as I believe my name is Chili Falls, that I will get on a cruise ship and be safer there than I am to go nine-tenths of a mile from my house to Kroger's
sentences.zh: 坚信，就像我坚信我的名字叫奇利·福尔斯一样，我登上游轮在那里的安全性，要远胜于我去离家十分之九英里的克罗格

sentences.en: I'm curious, what does your oncologist say?
